snippet.title: TRAILER LOOPIALIKE
snippet.description:
🔥 LoopiaLike — A bullet heaven roguelite where spell fusion changes everything.

Choose your wizard, survive endless waves of enemies, fuse spells into devastating combos, and become unstoppable. Every run is different. Every build is unique.

🧙 3 playable wizards, each with unique spell trees
⚔️ 30+ weapons that combine into powerful fusions
🎰 Slot-machine level-up system — risk vs reward
💀 Endless waves with elite enemies and epic bosses
🎵 Original soundtrack with adaptive music

🛒 WISHLIST NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4460390/LoopiaLike/

📅 Early Access Launch: March 20, 2026
💰 $9.99 USD

Built entirely by one solo developer in Godot 4.6.

If you love Vampire Survivors, Brotato, Soulstone Survivors, or Magic Survival — LoopiaLike is for you.

📌 Follow the development:
🔗 Press Kit: https://dsuarezmarra.github.io/loopialike/presskit.html
